messages:
aisha: Heads-up: were rolling a permanent SLO-tiering policy for streaming/chat endpoints starting next week. This is a policy change (not a maintenance) to formalize graceful degradation during regional pressure.

julia: TL;DR: two tiers — standard (SLO p99=150ms) and best-effort (SLO p99=350ms). Best-effort will automatically apply to non-critical tenant routes when regional capacity crosses 85%. Purpose: avoid hard outages and reduce noisy retries.

devon: Added rollout plan: opt-in beta for internal traffic Tues 02:00-04:00 UTC, then progressive enable across non-prod clusters Wed, prod canary (eu-west-1) Thu 01:30 for 20m, then global on Fri 01:00 if canary passes.

oncall: Please publish the success criteria. Ill be on pager for the canary.

aisha: Success criteria: error-rate delta <0.3% and p99 (standard routes) unchanged +/-20ms, best-effort p99 observed <350ms. If error bump >0.3% or standard p99 increases >50ms we abort.

ops-bot: policy-schedule created: policy-id=deg-policy-2026-01, canary-window=2026-06-04T01:30:00Z/2026-06-04T01:50:00Z, owner=@aisha.

julia: To reduce surprise for UIs/clients were adding a header: X-Redwood-Degradation: tier=best-effort;reason=capacity_pressure. That will help debug and customer comms.

devon: Command to enable canary (dry-run tested):
```
./infra/ctl policy apply --id deg-policy-2026-01 --mode canary --regions eu-west-1 --duration 20m --note "streaming-tiering canary"
```
Human rollback: `./infra/ctl policy disable --id deg-policy-2026-01`.

aisha: Also scheduling a short soaktest after canary: 30m progressive synthetic producers ramping to 500rps against streaming endpoints to validate token throughput and fallback to smaller model. Canary will be followed by a 10m isolation test that forcibly reduces capacity in eu-west to trigger auto-tiering.

degrader-bot: sample policy fragment added to ticket deg-2026-01:
```yaml
policy_id: deg-policy-2026-01
thresholds:
  region_pressure_pct: 85
  sustained_window: 3m
actions:
  - target: non_critical_routes
    set: best-effort
    changes: [max_tokens: 256, fallback_model: redwood-lite-v1]
  - target: logging
    emit_header: true
```

julia: Customer comms: nothing external yet. Product wants a short FAQ for impacted customers explaining header + mitigation. @marie please sync if outreach needed.

aisha: Monitoring list: per-region p99 heatmap, per-tenant error delta, X-Redwood-Degradation header counts, and fallback-model invocation rate. Please add alerts for >0.5% error delta or header rate >60% for >5m.

oncall: Ill own canary monitoring and will pause/roll back on alert. Pager contact = @oncall.

ops-bot: checklist appended to deg-2026-01: canary playbook, rollback steps, post-soak runbook, postmortem template.

devon: One more: lets run a short replay of last weeks traffic against the best-effort config in a staging cluster to sanity-check token decay and billing metrics. Ill kick that after lunch.

julia: Thanks. Please drop any short observations in this thread after tests. Well do a 30m sync the day after rollout to review metrics and decide on global enable. :wave:
